verdict.rationale: Factory publishes an API reference section (a Sessions API page) and serves an OpenAPI spec at docs.factory.ai/openapi.json, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/playground functionality, runnable code examples, reference coverage beyond the sessions endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
